1.subtitle: What is Budgeting?
1.text: Budgeting is the process of creating a plan for how to spend your money. This spending plan is called a budget. Having a budget helps you decide in advance whether you will have enough money to do the things you need or want to do.

1.subtitle: The 50/30/20 Method
1.text: One of the most popular methods is 50/30/20. Allocate 50% of your income for Needs, 30% for Wants, and 20% for Savings or Debt repayment.

1.subtitle: How to Get Started
1.text: 1. Record all income. 2. List all fixed expenses. 3. Evaluate variable expenses. 4. Adjust the allocation to match your financial targets.

2.subtitle: Why an Emergency Fund?
2.text: An emergency fund is money set aside specifically to cover living expenses when something unexpected happens, such as job loss or sudden medical bills.

2.subtitle: How Much Do You Need?
2.text: Ideally, aim for 3–6 months of living expenses. If your monthly expenses are Rp 5 million, your emergency fund target should be Rp 15–30 million.
